messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm adding a short geo-note for EU/CA processing into the localization guide. Need coordinated edits: SDK snippets, migration guide, and the small legal footnote. cc @kim @henry @jason :wave:

kim: Legal wants a very compact sentence and prefers "processed" over "routed". They also requested a parenthetical pointer to Private for strict in-country needs. I'll get a one-line OK.

jason: For the migration guide, we should show how to set REDWOOD_REGION and how the app behaves if the region is enforced vs. not. I'll draft a tiny troubleshooting item for the FAQ.

henry: SDK samples to include both header + env var. Proposal: show recommended header `X-Redwood-Region` and alias `X-Region` in a single example. Example JS + curl snippets below; will add fallback comments.

henry: ```
// JS SDK example (env var)
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, region: process.env.REDWOOD_REGION || 'global' })
await client.generate({ prompt: 'hi' })

// HTTP example (explicit header)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

maria: Can you also include a short sample response for the fallback case so implementers can wire up monitoring?

henry: Sure. I'll add this snippet in the migration guide: 
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
X-Redwood-Fallback: global
{
  "error": "requested region unavailable, served from fallback",
  "requested_region": "eu-west-1",
  "served_from": "global"
}
```

eva: Translation teams need the legal sentence as a single translatable string. l10n-bot please open a job and include context: where the sentence appears, character limits, and the Private pointer.

l10n-bot: created T-914: "geo processing footnote" with context: "short legal sentence linking to /legal/data-residency. Keep intact for translators. Attach Private deployment pointer."

kim: Legal approved the final line: "Content may be processed in regional infrastructure based on customer residency settings. Customers with strict in-country residency should use Redwood Private. See: /legal/data-residency". I'll paste that exact sentence into the PR comment.

jason: I'll open migration-guide PR 12999 with ENV var example, a short opt-in note, and the FAQ troubleshooting entry. Will include a reviewer checklist.

henry: Docs PR 12988 opened with SDK snippets + header alias + fallback examples and an inline footnote anchor. Requesting review from @maria and @kim. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12988

maria: Please add the l10n task id (T-914) and legal wording to the PR description. Also add a 1-line note for marketing that they may excerpt a short blurb for the Regions page after merge.

eva: Once merged I'll create the translation tasks and route FR/DE/ES/JA. l10n-bot, mark T-914 ready for translation.

l10n-bot: T-914 moved to "ready for translation" and assigned FR/DE/ES/JA vendors. Context attached.

kim: Minor ask — prefer we recommend `X-Redwood-Region` in docs to avoid collisions. If we show `X-Region` alias, put a bold note recommending the Redwood-prefixed header.

henry: Will do. Also added a short console log example for fallback detection: `console.warn('region fallback used:', res.headers['x-redwood-fallback'])` in the JS sample.

jason: Added a tiny checklist in migration PR: legal wording included, footnote anchor present, SDK sample shows header + env var + fallback, l10n task T-914 included. ETA for my PR: tomorrow morning.

maria: Reviewing PRs this afternoon. After merge, I'll update the docs checklist doc and ping marketing for the Regions blurb. If anything regresses, reopen or ping #docs.

henry: Thanks — I'll monitor comments post-merge and tweak snippets if people report collisions. :thumbsup:

l10n-bot: T-914 moved to "in translation" for FR/DE/ES/JA.

maria: End of thread — archiving and linking back to PRs for traceability.
